purpose: Separate spatial-null realization from the combined routing/initialization/minibatch seed; development only
primary: Validation EPE: average the three null graphs within each training/routing seed, then subtract from that seed's measured-graph EPE; report all three differences and overall mean
secondary: Validation MSE and complete 3x3 metric matrix; report variability across null graphs within each row and across row means
limits: Training seed still couples routing, initialization and minibatches. This design separates only null realization from that combined factor. No animal inference, equivalence claim or new confirmation.
launch_gate: Implement independent null seed with checkpoint provenance, verify diagonal backward compatibility on CPU, pass tests, check usage/active apps, then reserve. Do not repeat completed diagonal or measured trials.
